# convoy_send_event (Action)

Sends an event through Convoy: to one endpoint (`direct`), to every endpoint sharing an owner ID (`fanout`) or to every subscribed endpoint (`broadcast`). Useful to smoke-test a freshly provisioned endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "convoy_send_event" "ping_acme" {
  config {
    endpoint_id = convoy_endpoint.acme.id
    event_type  = "ping"
    data        = jsonencode({ message = "endpoint provisioned" })
  }
}

# Send a ping as soon as the endpoint is created...
resource "terraform_data" "acme_smoke_test" {
  input = convoy_endpoint.acme.id

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.convoy_send_event.ping_acme]
    }
  }
}

# ...or on demand: terraform apply -invoke=action.convoy_send_event.ping_acme
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String) JSON payload (use `jsonencode()`).
- `event_type` (String) Event type, e.g. `invoice.paid`.

### Optional

- `custom_headers` (Map of String) Extra headers sent with the event.
- `endpoint_id` (String) Target endpoint, for `direct` mode.
- `idempotency_key` (String) Key used by Convoy to de-duplicate the event.
- `mode` (String) `direct` (default, requires `endpoint_id`), `fanout` (requires `owner_id`) or `broadcast`.
- `owner_id` (String) Target owner ID, for `fanout` mode.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
